## Sets and graphs {: #sets-and-graphs }

## Lorentz-symmetric networks {: #lorentz-symmetric-networks }

<tr class="row-detail" id="lola-detail"><td colspan="4">

</td></tr>

<tr class="row" id="pelican"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="pelican-detail">PELICAN</button></td><td>Permutation-equivariant layers on Lorentz invariants</td><td>Four-vectors</td><td>2022</td></tr>
